hindi-speech-to-text.0: Hindi speech to text has quietly become one of the most useful features on Indian phones. Why? Speaking beats pecking out Devanagari on a cramped keyboard, and the same trick handles WhatsApp messages, emails, documents and notes alike.
hindi-speech-to-text.1: Below, you'll find how to switch on Hindi voice typing on every common device. Also covered: what suits long recordings and meetings, and how to sharpen accuracy.
hindi-speech-to-text.2: Hindi speech to text converts spoken Hindi into written text as you speak, usually in Devanagari script. Other names: Hindi voice typing, Hindi dictation. Point that same technology at recordings rather than live speech and it becomes [Hindi transcription](https://lynkk.ai/blog/hindi-transcription).
hindi-speech-to-text.5: Gboard's output lands in Devanagari. Prefer Roman-script Hinglish? Add the Hinglish or Hindi (Latin) keyboard layout and dictate there instead.
hindi-speech-to-text.7: Dictation follows whichever keyboard is active. Words appearing in English? Switch keyboards first, then tap the mic.
hindi-speech-to-text.8: The easiest free Hindi speech to text online is Google Docs voice typing, which lists Hindi as a supported language and runs in Chrome, Edge and Safari ([Google Docs Help](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/4492226)). Windows, Mac and Chromebook all qualify:
hindi-speech-to-text.9: No cost, no time limit. The catch is a stable internet connection, and the Doc must stay open throughout. Spoken punctuation commands understand English only, so Hindi punctuation goes in by hand.
hindi-speech-to-text.10: Yes. On Windows 10 and 11, Google Docs voice typing in Chrome or Edge is the most reliable free route for Hindi. Windows' own voice typing (Windows key + H) varies: supported languages depend on your Windows version and installed language packs. So check whether Hindi appears in your list.
hindi-speech-to-text.11: Macs ship with dictation covering many languages. Open **System Settings**, then **Keyboard**, turn on **Dictation**, and add Hindi under dictation languages if your macOS version offers it. Want more Mac options? Our guide to [dictation on Mac](https://lynkk.ai/blog/dictation-on-mac) covers them.
hindi-speech-to-text.12: The best Hindi speech to text app depends on what you are capturing. Messages? Your phone keyboard is enough. Documents suit Google Docs voice typing well, while meetings and long conversations call for an AI meeting tool that supports Hindi.
hindi-speech-to-text.13: Live voice typing breaks down in meetings. Several people speak, nobody wants to hold a phone, and the conversation keeps hopping between Hindi and English. An AI meeting assistant copes better.
hindi-speech-to-text.14: Lynkk (our product) records Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls through a bot, and in-person or bot-free meetings through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Hindi is supported, along with a **Hinglish setting** for mid-sentence switching. Each meeting ends with a transcript, an English summary, tasks carrying owners and dates, and a decision log. Hunting for an earlier detail? Ask Lynkk searches past meetings and cites the exact moment.
hindi-speech-to-text.15: Across 17 languages plus auto-detect (Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali in beta), Lynkk can also pin data processing to India. Free covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each. Pro: $15 a month.
hindi-speech-to-text.17: Yes. Gboard on Android supports voice typing in many Indian languages, including Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada and Malayalam, and Google Docs voice typing handles several of them too. Setup mirrors Hindi. Add the language in keyboard settings, then dictate.
hindi-speech-to-text.18: Meetings are a separate case: Lynkk covers 17 languages plus auto-detect, with Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali in beta. Does your team work across 2 or 3 Indian languages? Then test each one with a real 10-minute meeting before any rollout. Our [Google Meet AI note takers for India](https://lynkk.ai/blog/google-meet-ai-note-taker) guide compares language support across meeting tools.
hindi-speech-to-text.20: In meetings, keep the device within 1 metre of the speakers. And ask people not to talk over each other during decisions.
hindi-speech-to-text.21: Yes. [Google Cloud Speech-to-Text](https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-supported-languages) lists Hindi (hi-IN) as a supported language in its paid API, and several other cloud providers and AI labs offer Hindi speech recognition too. That route suits developers building apps. Everyday users? Stick with the free keyboard and Docs options above; they're simpler.
hindi-speech-to-text.22: Use Gboard voice typing on Android, the iPhone keyboard microphone, or Google Docs voice typing in Chrome with हिन्दी selected. All three cost nothing. One snag: spoken punctuation commands in Google Docs understand only English, so add Hindi full stops and commas by hand after dictating.
hindi-speech-to-text.23: Gboard on Android or the iPhone keyboard for messages, Google Docs voice typing for documents, and Lynkk for Hindi or Hinglish meetings, which it records and summarises automatically. Recorded files need an AI transcription tool that supports Hindi. Test it on 5 minutes of your own audio before relying on it.
hindi-speech-to-text.24: Yes. Open Google Docs in Chrome, Edge or Safari, go to Tools, then Voice typing, and select हिन्दी. Windows, Mac and Chromebook laptops all work. Headphones with a microphone improve accuracy, and keep the Doc open while you speak, because typing stops when the tab closes.
hindi-speech-to-text.25: Partly. Some phone keyboards support offline voice typing after you download the language pack, while Google Docs voice typing needs an internet connection. Offline modes help in low-connectivity areas. Accuracy can dip below online voice typing, though, so check names and numbers afterward.
hindi-speech-to-text.26: Yes. Use a Hinglish or Hindi (Latin) keyboard layout on your phone, and dictation will write Hindi words in Roman script. Handy for WhatsApp messages and informal notes. Formal documents are another story: Devanagari output is usually easier for other Hindi readers to scan.
hindi-speech-to-text.27: Upload the recording to an AI transcription tool that supports Hindi, or use an AI meeting assistant like Lynkk to capture future meetings automatically with transcript, summary and tasks. With older recordings, keep audio clear. Very long files may need splitting into parts if your tool caps file length.
